A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'sā' 2981 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) ثابپ s̤ābit
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثابپ s̤ābit (act. part. ثبپ 'to continue, last,' &c.), adj. Continuing, subsisting, lasting, enduring, remaining; remaining fixed or stationary, standing, resting; permanent, constant, firm, steady, steadfast, stable, fixed, fast, settled, established, confirmed, proved, ascertained; sound, valid, substantial, real, sure, certain, true, right, correct, just, proper: — s̤ābit rahnā (- meṅ , or - par ), To continue firm (in); to adhere or stick (to); to be obstinate (in respect of): — s̤ābit-qadam , adj. Firm, immovable, stable, steady, steadfast; permanent, constant; resolute, determined; persevering; — s̤ābit-qadam karnā (with acc. - ko of person, and loc. - par of thing), To render or make (one) firm, steady, or constant, &c. (in, or in respect of): — s̤ābit karnā (- ko ), To confirm (in, - par ), to establish, render durable; to prove, verify, bring home (to, - par ), substantiate: — s̤ābit honā , v.n. To be confirmed, be established, be proved, &c. 2) ثابپ خاني s̤ābit-ḵẖānī
                        ( p. 368 ) A P ثابپ خاني s̤ābit-ḵẖānī , s.m. A kind of soldier or armed retainer (dressed, probably, agreeably to the device of one Sābit Khān ). 3) ثاقب s̤āqib
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثاقب s̤āqib (act. part. of ثقب 'to pierce'), adj. lit . 'Penetrating'; shining brightly, glistening, gleaming very brightly, brilliant, splendid; famous, exalted, sublime, high. 4) ثالث s̤ālis̤
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثالث s̤ālis̤ (act. part. of ثلث 'to form a third,' &c.), adj. & s.m. Third; — a third person, a mediator, arbitrator, umpire: — s̤ālis̤ biʼl-ḵẖair , s.m. An unprejudiced or impartial arbitrator: — s̤ālis̤-s̤alās̤a , s.m. Trinity ( = tas̤līs̤ ): — s̤ālis̤-nāma , s.m. An award by arbitration or by a jury, a deed of award. 5) ثالثه s̤ālis̤a
                        ( p. 368 ) P ثالثه s̤ālis̤a (for A. ثالثة s̤ālis̤at , fem. of s̤ālis̤ ), adj. & s.f. Third; — mediatrix, arbitress. 6) ثالثي s̤ālis̤ī
                        ( p. 368 ) A H ثالثي s̤ālis̤ī , s.f. Mediation, arbitration. 7) ثالوث s̤ālūs̤
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثالوث s̤ālūs̤ , s.m. The Trinity: — s̤alūs̤-ě-aqdas , The most holy Trinity. 8) ثامن s̤āmin
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثامن s̤āmin (act. part. of ثمن 'to be the eighth'), adj. (fem. s̤āmina ), Eighth. 9) ثاني s̤ānī
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثاني s̤ānī (act. part. of ثني 'to double'), adj. & s.m.f. Second; — a second; match, equal: — s̤āniyuʼl-hāl , adv. A second or another time, secondly: — s̤ānī mulāḥaz̤a , s.m. A second inspection, revision. 10) ثانياً s̤āniyan, s̤āniyā
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثانياً s̤āniyan , s̤āniyā (acc. of s̤ānī ), adv. Secondly, in the second place. 11) ثانيه s̤āniya
                        ( p. 368 ) P ثانيه s̤āniya (for A. ثانية s̤āniyat , fem. of s̤ānī ), adj. & s.f. Second; — a second, a moment. 12) ثيات s̤abāt
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثيات s̤abāt (from ثبت ; see s̤ābit ), s.m. Continuance, subsistency, durability, permanence, stability, endurance; constancy, firmness, steadiness, steadfastness, fixedness; resolution, determination; soundness, validity. 13) ثبب s̤abt
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثبب s̤abt , s.f. Permanence; firmness, stability, fixedness, fixing; impression; a seal, writing: — s̤abt karnā , v.t. To impress, to insert, enter, inscribe, to affix (a signture), to subscribe, to write: — s̤abt-honā , v.n. To be inscribed, be written. 14) ثرا s̤arā
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثرا s̤arā (from ثرو ), adj. Opulent, rich; — s.m. The earth. 15) ثروت s̤arwat
                        ( p. 368 ) P ثروت s̤arwat (for A. ثروة ), s.f. Much or a great quantity (of property), wealth, affluence; a great number, a multitude; power, authority, influence: — s̤arwatu-hu , His wealth. 16) ثعلب s̤aʻlab
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثعلب s̤aʻlab , s.m. A fox: — s̤aʻlab-miṣrī , s.f. Salep, the root of a species of orchis, Orchis mascula (considered, particularly in the East, to be a strong restorative and aphrodisiac). 17) ثقالت s̤aqālat, s̤iqālat
                        ( p. 368 ) P ثقالت s̤aqālat , vulg. s̤iqālat (for A. ثقالة , inf. n. of ثقل 'to be heavy'), s.f. Heaviness, weight; heavy load, indigestion ( = s̤iql ). 18) ثقيل s̤aqīl
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثقيل s̤aqīl (v.n. of ثقل ), adj. Heavy, weighty, ponderous; hard to be borne, onerous, burdensome, oppressive, afflictive; indigestible; slow, sluggish, indolent, lazy, phlegmatic; dull, torpid, inactive. 19) ثلاث s̤alās̤
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثلاث s̤alās̤ (from ثلث ; see s̤ālis̤ ), adj. (prop. fem. of s̤alās̤at ), Three. 20) ثمانيه s̤amāniya
                        ( p. 368 ) P ثمانيه s̤amāniya (for A. ثمانية s̤amānīyat , fr. ثمن 'to form an eighth), s.m. lit . 'Eight'; (in Arith.) double rule of three. 21) ثمر s̤amar
                        ( p. 368 ) A ثمر s̤amar = P ثمره s̤amara , vulg. s̤amra ( s̤amara , for A. ثمرة s̤amarat , fem.), s.m. Fruit; produce; advantage, profit; result, product; recompense, reward; offspring: — s̤amar-baḵẖsh , adj. Fruit-yielding, productive of fruit: — s̤amar-dār , adj. Fruit-bearing, fruitful. 22) ثمره s̤amara, s̤amra
                        ( p. 368 ) P ثمره s̤amara , vulg. s̤amra = A ثمر s̤amar ( s̤amara , for A. ثمرة s̤amarat , fem.), s.m. Fruit; produce; advantage, profit; result, product; recompense, reward; offspring: — s̤amar-baḵẖsh , adj. Fruit-yielding, productive of fruit: — s̤amar-dār , adj. Fruit-bearing, fruitful. 23) ثمن s̤aman
                        ( p. 369 ) H ثمن s̤aman (corr. of the English), s.m. A summons (also, and more corr., written saman ): — s̤aman jārī karnā , v.n. To issue a summons. 24) ثمن s̤aman
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثمن s̤aman (see next), s.m. Price, value, estimated worth. 25) ثمين s̤amīn
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثمين s̤amīn , adj. High-priced, of high value, valuable, precious. 26) ثنا s̤anā
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثنا s̤anā , s.f. Praise, eulogy, commendation, applause (it differs from ḥamd in having for its object either the Deity or man, whereas ḥamd is restricted to the Deity): — s̤anā-ḵẖẉān , adj. & s.m. Repeating praise, praising; — one who praises, praiser; s̤anā-gustar , adj. & s.m. Scattering praise; — one who scatters praise: — s̤anā-gustarī , s.f. The scattering of praise. 27) ثواب s̤awāb
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثواب s̤awāb (v.n. from ثوب 'to return'), s.m. Recompense, compensation, requital, or reward (especially, of obedience to God); the reward of virtue in the future state; a meritorious or virtuous act: — s̤awāb-kā , adj. (f. - ī ), Virtuous, meriting reward in the future. 28) ثوابت s̤awābit
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثوابت s̤awābit , s.m. pl. (of s̤ābil , q.v.), The fixed stars (opp. to saiyāra , 'planets'). 29) ثوابي s̤awābī
                        ( p. 369 ) A P ثوابي s̤awābī , adj. Meritorious, virtuous ( = s̤awāb-kā , q.v.). 30) ثواني s̤awānī
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثواني s̤awānī , adj. & s.f. pl. of s̤āniya , q.v. 31) ثوب s̤aub
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثوب s̤aub (fr. ثوب 'to return'), s.m. A garment, robe, vestment. 32) ثور s̤aur
                        ( p. 369 ) A ثور s̤aur , s.m. A bull; the constellation Taurus, one of the signs of the Zodiac; the redness rising and spreading in the faint light that is seen above the horizon between sunset and nightfall; twilight, crepuscule; — the name of a mountain near Mecca. 33) ثيبه s̤aiyiba
                        ( p. 369 ) P ثيبه s̤aiyiba , (for A. ثيبة s̤aiyibat , for s̤aiyīb , orig. s̤awīb ), s.f. A young woman who has consummated her marriage, or one that is not a virgin. 34) س sa
                        ( p. 621 ) S س स sa , insep. prefix, With, together with, along with; having, possessing, accompanied by, &c. (it is combined with nouns to form adjectives and adverbs). 35) سا sā
                        ( p. 621 ) H P سا सा sā [Prk. सरिअओ or सलिअओ ; S. सट्टश + कः ], adj. suffix, (f. - ī ), Like, resembling, as (it is annexed to the accusatival base of adjectives, substantives, and participles, and to the formative or oblique base of the personal pronouns, and forms adjectives; e.g. kālā-sā , 'black-like,' 'blackish'; laṛkā-sā , 'boy-like,' 'boyish'; tujh-sā (rarely tu-sā ), 'like thee'; terā-sā , 'like thine'). 36) سا sā
                        ( p. 621 ) H سا सा sā [S. शस् , the Taddhita affix], adv. suffix (f. - ī ), Very, intensely, &c. (it is annexed to adjectives, and to the relative, interrogative, and indefinite pronouns; and forms adjectives with an intensified signification; e.g. kālā-sā , 'very black'; bahut-sā , 'very much or many,' 'a great deal of,' 'a great many'; thorā-sā , 'very little'; kaun-sā , 'which particular one' (out of a number)?; koʼī-sā , 'any one whatever'; kućh-sā , 'somewhat'). 37) سا sā
                        ( p. 621 ) P سا sā [rt. of sūdan ; = Zend śā = S. शा ( शो , श्यति )], imperf. part. Rubbing, wearing; polishing; anointing; drawing (used as last member of compounds). 38) ساباسي sābāsī
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساباسي साबासी sābāsī , 1˚, s.m. corr. of sahwāsī , q.v.; — 2˚, s.f. corr. of shābāshī , q.v. 39) سابدهان sābadhān
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابدهان साबधान sābadhān , adj. = sāvadhān , q.v. 40) سابر sābar
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابر साबर sābar [S. शम्बरः ], s.m. A large species of stag, a kind of elk; — leather of elk's (or any kind of deer's) hide, chamois, wash-leather. 41) سابر sābar
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابر साबर sābar [Prk. सावरो ; S. शावरः ], adj. & s.m. Belonging to a savage or barbarian, barbarous; — a barbarian, a low man: — sābar-mantr , s.m. A mantra composed in a barbarous or colloquial language (such as one of the Prākrits). 42) سابر sābar
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابر साबर sābar , s.m. = sābal , q.v. 43) سابست sābast
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابست साबस्त sābast , = H سابستي साबस्ती sābastī , s.f. corr. of sahavasatī , q.v. 44) سابستي sābastī
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابستي साबस्ती sābastī , = H سابست साबस्त sābast , s.f. corr. of sahavasatī , q.v. 45) سابع sāběʻ
                        ( p. 621 ) A سابع sāběʻ , adj. Seventh. 46) سابعا sāběʻaṉ
                        ( p. 621 ) A سابعا sāběʻaṉ (acc. of sāběʻ ), adv. Seventhly, in the seventh place. 47) سابق sābiq
                        ( p. 621 ) A سابق sābiq (act. part. of سبق 'to precede,' &c.), adj. & s.m. Preceding, foregoing, former, prior, past, ancient; — past time, former times; — adv. = sābiq-meṅ , q.v.: — sābiquʼl-anʻām , s.m. Former bounties: — sābiquʼẕ-ẕikr , adj. Before-mentioned: — sābiq-dastūr , adv. According to former practice, as before, as usual; — sābiq-meṅ , adv. Formerly, of yore, in times past, heretofore. 48) سابقًا sābiqaṉ
                        ( p. 621 ) A سابقًا sābiqaṉ (acc. of sābiq ), adv. Before, &c. ( = sābiq-meṅ ); as formerly, as before. 49) سابقه sābiqa
                        ( p. 621 ) P سابقه sābiqa (for A. سابقة sābiqat , fem. of sābiq ), adj. Preceding, &c. ( = sābiq , q.v.); — s.f. The past; ancient right or custom; — pre-excellence, pre-eminence, priority, precedence, superiority; — long-standing acquaintance, friendship, intimacy, close intercourse, correspondence; business (with), transaction, dealings: — sābiqa paṛnā (- se ), To become acquainted (with), to be brought into close intercourse (with), to have to deal (with): — sābiqa ḍālnā (- se ), To cast (one's, - kā ) lot (with), to bring (one) into close connection (with). 50) سابل sābal
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابل साबल sābal [S. शर्वला ], s.m.(?) An iron crow or lever; an instrument used by burglars to break into houses; — a small anvil ( = sābar ). 51) سابن sābun
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابن साबुन sābun (corr. of A. صابون , q.v.), s.m. Soap: — sābun-kā phen , s.m. Lather, soap-suds. 52) سابوت sābūt
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابوت साबूत sābūt , adj. corr. of ثبوت s̤abūt , q.v. 53) سابون sābūn
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابون साबून sābūn , s.m. = sābun , q.v. 54) سابوني sābūnī
                        ( p. 621 ) H سابوني sābūnī , s.f. corr. of صابوني ṣbūnī , q.v. 55) ساپ sāp
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپ साप sāp , s.m. 1˚ = شاپ śāp ; — 2˚, corr. of sāṅp , qq.v. 56) ساپا sāpā
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپا सापा sāpā [prob. S. शाप + कः ], s.m. Mourning (see sāṅpā ). 57) ساپا sāpā
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپا सापा sāpā , 1˚, s.m. = sāp , q.v.; — 2˚, adj. (rustic) corr. of صفا safā , q.v. 58) ساپرادهہ sāparādh
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساپرادهہ सापराध sāparādh ( sa + ap˚ ), adj. Faulty, offending, criminal, guilty. 59) ساپت sāpit, sāpat
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپت सापित sāpit , सापत sāpat , part. adj. = شاپت śāpit , q.v. 60) ساپن sāpan
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپن सापन sāpan [prob. S. शपनं or शापनं ], s.m. Name of a disorder in which the hair gradually falls off. 61) ساپن sāpin
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپن सापिन sāpin , s.f. = sāṅpin , q.v. 62) ساپنا sāpnā
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساپنا सापना sāpnā , v.t. = شاپنا śāpnā , q.v. 63) ساپهليه sāphalya
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساپهليه साफल्य sāphalya (fr. sa-phala ), s.m. Productiveness, fruitfulness; profit, advantage; success; effectiveness, efficiency. 64) ساپيکش sāpeksha, sāpeksh
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساپيکش सापेक्ष sāpeksha , vulg. sāpeksh ( sa + ap˚ ), adj. Having regard or respect (to), relative (to), dependent (on), proper, expedient. 65) ساپيکشتا sāpekshatā
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساپيکشتا सापेक्षता sāpekshatā , = S ساپيکشيتا सापेक्ष्यता sāpekshyatā , s.f. Dependence (on); exigency; need, necessity; expediency. 66) ساپيکشيتا sāpekshyatā
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساپيکشيتا सापेक्ष्यता sāpekshyatā , = S ساپيکشتا सापेक्षता sāpekshatā , s.f. Dependence (on); exigency; need, necessity; expediency. 67) سات sāt
                        ( p. 621 ) H سات सात sāt [S. सप्त ; Prk. सत्त ], adj. Seven: — sātārohaṇ (S. sapta + ār˚ ), s.m. Seven wolves which keep together; a dog which associates with six wolves; — a company (of persons); a large family: — sāt-bhāʼī , s.m. lit . 'Seven brothers'; a name of certain gregarious birds (so called from their being generally seen in flocks of seven): — sāt-pāṅć , adj. & s.m. lit . 'Five or seven'; five or six; several; a few; — five or six persons, a number of persons; — s.f. Tricks, trickery: — sāt-pāṅć karnā (- se , or - ke sāth ), To wrangle (with); — to practise tricks or trickery (with or upon); — to be in doubt, to be unable to decide what to do: — sāt-samundar , s.m. lit . 'Seven seas'; name of a game. 68) سات sāt
                        ( p. 621 ) H سات सात sāt , contrac. of ساتهہ sāth , q.v. 69) ساتاروهن sātārohaṇ
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتاروهن सातारोहण sātārohaṇ , s.m. See s.v. sāt . 70) ساتسار sātisār
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساتسار सातिसार sātisār ( sa + āt˚ ), adj. & s.m. (f. ā ), Afflicted with dysentery, dysenteric; — a person afflicted with dysentery. 71) ساتمو sātmau
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتمو सातमौ sātmau , adj. (Braj) = sātwāṅ , q.v. 72) ساتو sātū
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتو सातू sātū , s.m. 1˚ = sattū ; — 2˚ = satwā , qq.v. 73) ساتو sāto, sātū
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتو सातो sāto , सातू sātū , adj. &c. = sātoṅ , q.v. 74) ساتوان sātwāṅ
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتوان सातवां sātwāṅ [Prk. सत्तमओ , or सत्तवँओ ; S. सप्तम + कः ], adj. (f. - wīṅ ), Seventh. 75) ساتور sātūr
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتور सातूर sātūr [Prk. सत्थउल्लो ; S. शस्त्र + उलः ], s.m. (dialec.), A large knife; a butcher's chopping knife or cleaver. 76) ساتوك sāttvik, sātvik
                        ( p. 621 ) S ساتوك सात्त्विक sāttvik , सात्विक sātvik (fr. sat-tva ), adj. Endowed with the Sattva Guṇ (i.e. purity or goodness; see guṇ , and sattva ); appertaining to that quality; real, genuine, true, veritable, honest, sincere, good, virtuous, pure, excellent, amiable; — s.m. An excellent or amiable, &c. person; a Brāhmaṇ. 77) ساتون sātoṅ
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتون सातों sātoṅ [format. or obl. pl. of sāt = S. सप्तानां , gen. pl. of saptan ; Prk. सत्तंहं ], adj. & collec, s.m. The seven, the whole seven, all the seven; — the seven of them: — sātoṅ kāṇḍ , s.m. The seven sections into which the Rāmāyan of Tulsī Dās is divided: — sātoṅ dvīp , s.m. The seven divisions of the world as recognized in the Hindū system. 78) ساتوه sātwa
                        ( p. 621 ) H ساتوه सात्व sātwa , s.m. corr. of sattva , q.v. 79) ساتوين sātwīn
                        ( p. 622 ) H ساتوين सातवीं sātwīn [S. सप्तमी ; see sātwāṅ ], s.f. The seventh day of the lunar fortnight. 80) ساتهہ sāth
                        ( p. 622 ) H ساتهہ साथ sāth [Prk. सत्थो ; S. सार्थः ; and Prk. सत्थं ; S. संस्थं ], s.m. Troop, band, herd, flock; company, society; accompaniment, regular attendant, concomitant, that which regularly or invariably accompanies or is taken with (a thing, as a relish, &c.); — postpn. & adv. In the company (of, - ke , or mere ), in company (with), along (with), in connection (with), with, together; towards; for: — sāth iske (or us-ke ), adv. Along with this (or that), besides, moreover; notwithstanding this, although: — sāth - (or sāt -) baṭe ʻadad , s.m. (in Alg.) Commensurable number: — sāth denā (- meṅ ), To take part (in), lend oneself (to), to join, to associate (with), to co-operate (with), to help; to take the part or side (of): — sāth-sāth , adv. With, together, in one company, along (with, - ke ), in society (with); keeping together, in order or time, evenly, &c. (as in marching, &c.): — sāth kone-kī nāp , s.f. (in Trig.), Cosine of an angle: — sāth lag-lenā (- ke ) = sāth ho-lenā , q.v.: — sāth-lage phirnā (- ke ), To follow (one) about: — sāth lenā , v.t. To take with (one, apne ), take in (one's) company; to carry away with (one): — sāth - (or sāt -) na-baṭe ʻadad , s.m. (in Alg.), Incommensurable number: — sāth-wālā , s.m. Companion, &c. ( = sāthī , q.v.): — sātho-sāth , or sāthoṅ-sāth , adv. = sāth-sāth , q.v.: — sāth ho-lenā (- ke ), To go in the company (of), to accompany, to become or make one of a company, to join: — sāth-hī , adv. Along (with, - ke ); immediately, immediately upon: — sāthī-sāth ( sāth +emphat. part. ī ), adv. = sāth-sāth , q.v. 81) ساتها sāthā
                        ( p. 622 ) H ساتها साथा sāthā , s.m. (poet.) = sāth , q.v. 82) ساتهري sāthrī
                        ( p. 622 ) H ساتهري साथरी sāthrī [prob. S. सत्र , rt. सद् + इका ], s.f. A small carpet or mat on which a Hindū sits to worship. 83) ساتهن sāthin, sāthan

                        ( p. 741 ) ص ṣād or swād (called ṣād-ě-mǒhmala or ṣād-ě-g̠air-manqūt̤a ), is the twentieth letter of the Urdū alphabet (the fourteenth of the Arabic, from which it is taken). It occurs almost exclusively in words borrowed from the Arabic or in the secondary formations from such words. In the few Persian words in which it is found, it has been substituted, in modern times, for the original sīn or s , to distinguish them, it is affirmed, from others of a different signification (e.g. ṣad , 'one hundred,' for orig. sad ; and shaṣt , 'sixty,' for orig. shast ; to prevent their being confounded with sad , 'a wall'; and shast , 'an aim'). In Arabic it is a strongly articulated palatal s , somewhat like our ss in hiss ; but in Persian and Hindūstānī its pronunciation is hardly distinguishable from that of sīn . In reckoning according to the abjad , q.v., its value is 90. As an abbreviation, it is used for, 1˚ ṣaḥīḥ , written on documents or accounts to indicate that they have been examined or checked, &c. 2˚ for ṣafar , the name of the second month in the Arabian calendar: — ṣād karnā , v.t.
